before.cause: The settings notification ran inside the HMR AsyncLocalStorage context; immediate settings.update was rejected before persistence.

input.operation: Append a model containing only id to providers.cpa.models, using the current numeric expectedRevision.

redBeforeGreen: models saved during an HMR transaction receive their missing thinking levels
mounting the plugin inside HMR also reconciles outside the mount transaction
consecutive GUI saves keep the pending pass after a revision conflict
a catalog listing that finishes after disposal cannot submit a new settings write

boundaries: The fix uses the private hmr.executing AsyncLocalStorage of the tested DSH version; future DSH upgrades require revalidation.
Harness capability and pre-dispatch validation were checked; upstream provider acceptance of each wire value was not tested.
The existing GUI HTTP endpoint and modelCatalog API were verified; no browser DOM click test was performed.
